Package com.im.njams.sdk

Class NjamsSerializers

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.NjamsSerializers
  • public class NjamsSerializers
extends Object
    Owns the Serializer registry of an Njams client and serializes arbitrary objects to strings for activity data. Obtain via njams.serializers().

    • Method Detail

      • add

        public <T> Serializer<T> add​(Class<T> key,
                             Serializer<? super T> serializer)
        Adds a Serializer for serializing a given class.
        Uses serialize(java.lang.Object) to serialize instances of this class with the registered serializer. If a serializer is already registered, it will be replaced with the new serializer.
        Type Parameters:
        T - Type that the given instance serializes
        Parameters:
        key - Class for which the serializer should be registered
        serializer - A serializer that can serialize instances of class key to strings.
        Returns:
        If a serializer for the same type was already registered before, the former registered serializer is returned. Otherwise null is returned.

      • remove

        public <T> Serializer<T> remove​(Class<T> key)
        Removes the serialier with the given class key. If not serializer is registered yet, null will be returned.
        Type Parameters:
        T - type of the class
        Parameters:
        key - a class
        Returns:
        Registered serializer or null

      • get

        public <T> Serializer<T> get​(Class<T> key)
        Gets the serializer for exactly the given class key. If no serializer is registered yet, null will be returned. This implementation does not consider the class hierarchy. See also find(Class).
        Type Parameters:
        T - type of the class
        Parameters:
        key - a class
        Returns:
        Registered serializer or null
        See Also:
        find(Class)

      • serialize

        public <T> String serialize​(T t)
        Serializes a given object using find(java.lang.Class) with no effective size limit.
        Type Parameters:
        T - type of the class
        Parameters:
        t - Object to be serialized
        Returns:
        a string representation of the object, or null if t is null, or "" when the serializer threw

      • serialize

        public <T> SerializerResult serialize​(T t,
                                      int sizeLimit)
        Serializes a given object using find(java.lang.Class), passing sizeLimit through to the resolved Serializer, and reporting whether the output was truncated.

        The value may slightly exceed sizeLimit due to serializer-specific buffering. sizeLimit <= 0 or Integer.MAX_VALUE mean "no limit" (never truncated).

        Type Parameters:
        T - type of the class
        Parameters:
        t - Object to be serialized
        sizeLimit - Approximate maximum length of the produced string
        Returns:
        the serialized value and its truncation flag, null if t is null, or an empty, non-truncated result when the serializer threw

      • find

        public <T> Serializer<? super T> find​(Class<T> clazz)
        Gets the serializer with the given class key. If no serializer is registered yet, the superclass hierarchy will be checked recursively. If neither the class nor any superclass is registered, the interface hierarchy will be checked recursively. if no (super) interface is registered, null will be returned.
        Type Parameters:
        T - Type of the class
        Parameters:
        clazz - Class for which a serializer will be searched.
        Returns:
        Serializer or null.
